title: Space Age

card.teaser: A rosé label with an astronaut, and a vineyard reflected in the visor.

summary: A rosé label with an astronaut, and a vineyard reflected in the visor.
meta: Front and back labels, astronaut illustration, bottle capsule, prototypes

hero.alt: A hand holding a Space Age rosé bottle with an astronaut on the label.

overview.challenge: Bring something unexpected to wine packaging without losing the product inside the concept.
overview.solution: An astronaut as the focal point, with a vineyard reflected in the visor to tie outer space back to where wine comes from.
overview.outcome: A label system across the front, back and capsule, tested as printed prototypes and bottle mockups.
